conclusions.text: The complete 363-ID assignment is preserved. Source overlay evidence supports 110 additive candidate payloads bound to 33 current stable locations: 41 candidates have complete retained-source coverage, and 69 have partial retained-source coverage with exact candidate-minus-source remainders; 10 additional New Caledonia cases have no positive-area match.

253 IDs remain held for the specific source or land-support reasons in the complete ledger. Native-grid acceptance, full assignment conservation, unsupported remainder resolution, processing cause, historic water or ice, physical truth, legal boundary authority and publication approval remain unresolved.

methods.area_method: Planar Shapely overlay in geographic coordinates; reported source covered fractions are derived from exact overlay areas and are not geodesic ground-area estimates.
methods.description: Exact geometry intersections and candidate-minus-source-union differences; source-positive areas create source-relative proposals. No snapping or tolerance is applied. Candidate and source feature hashes are retained in outputs.
methods.distance_method: No distance-based matching used; candidate-to-source association requires positive-area intersection.
methods.software: Python with Shapely; repository immutable evidence helpers; per-run environment receipts
methods.units: longitude-latitude degrees for overlay inputs; area ratios are dimensionless

methods.description: Preserve each of the 363 assigned IDs once and count complete, partial, unmatched and held outcomes from the final ledger.
methods.software: Python standard library; ledger-generation scripts and pinned run receipts
